_doc: Char-count baseline for each LLM-facing payload. PromptSizeProbeTest derives ceiling as chars × 1.15 in code; there is no manual ceiling here. On growth past ceiling: trim the prompt. On shrinkage below 'chars': run `bazel run //src/test:update_prompt_baselines` to rewrite this file, then commit. Each entry carries 'updatedBy' (PR or issue ref) and 'reason' for audit trail; the updater stamps 'auto' / dated 'regenerated' when an entry changes, leaving you to refine those fields before committing.

contractPrompt.reason: epic #696 stated the flow degree rules, the DEFAULT bypass rule, and the MESSAGE boundary kind in the extraction prompt; #703 corrected the branch-kind/decision-kind rule to match the validator

contractFullPayload.reason: widened the PARALLEL keyword list on FlatContractDecision.kind so a source that says 'concurrently' / 'strands' / 'tracks' is recognised as a parallel fork

contractRetryPrompt.reason: new probe: the extraction prompt on a corrective retry, which additionally carries the rejected contract and its issues. The first-attempt probe leaves those unset, so the largest variant of this prompt was previously unmeasured

contractRetryFullPayload.reason: new probe: same as contractRetryPrompt, plus the FlatProcessContract schema payload

generationPrompt.reason: contract markdown projection now renders activity modifiers (boundary events, iteration, loop) — previously omitted entirely

alignmentPrompt.reason: contract JSON carries the widened boundary-event vocabulary

readinessFullPayload.reason: evidence chain narrowed: sourceType and two evidence lists removed (#696)

repairPatchPrompt.reason: signal/escalation vocabulary widened the contract schema (#696)

repairFullPrompt.reason: signal/escalation vocabulary widened the contract schema (#696)
